what: The Plan sheet over the item page: what the person wants, the price, the lowest they take, the sites, the price drops, each with what the agent will do (spec/pages.md §6.7).
frame: Who: Sam setting a plan once per item, or changing it when something is slow; Dana adjusting the floor or sites on many items.
Came to do: say what they want (sell, gone fast, best price, only at my price, just checking) and see what each means in days and money kept.
Costliest mistake: a price under the lowest they take applied without a tap, a site posted they did not want (friends on Facebook), or drops they did not ask for.

Ways out (ways-out.md §6.7): type my own price, the suggestion kept as one line beside it; skip a site, or add an avoided one anyway (edge-cases §11); price drops off; every adjustment open under any choice.

The person stays in the loop at: the price (a guess until typed; a typed price far outside the sold range asks once, edge-cases §3), the lowest (a guess until set; one over the price is refused in place), any price under the lowest, which always waits for a tap, and each site's returns rule in one line.
decisions: A site switch flips the agent's pick: a picked site becomes skipped, a linked site it left out is added (ways-out §6.7 skip a site, and §11 an avoided site can be added; a switch that does nothing is a hollow control).
A blocked site's switch is disabled with 'Not allowed here' and platform-fit's reason; an avoided one is greyed with its reason and stays switchable (edge-cases §11, from platform-fit.json verdicts).
Each postable site shows its returns rule in one caption line (edge-cases §10 Returns terms: the person assumes they can refuse a return).
A typed price over 3 times the top or under a third of the bottom of the range asks once with the range; Preview and Save wait for 'Yes' (edge-cases §3 and ways-out §6.7 'Oops, $500, I meant $50').

For a draft the foot is Preview listings, which closes the sheet and opens the Post preview with the price and site flips; for a live item it is an Approve that saves (pages.md §6.7 pill: Preview listings; nothing goes public from the plan).

The sheet is a route, drawn over the item, sliding up from the foot and back down; a drag on the grabber closes it (Sheets open from their origin and close the way they came (frontend standard, Emil)).

Prices across sites shows the rule this item uses, the account's (Same take-home for a new seller) unless the person picks another for this item: its name, its reason in one line, and each site's numbers a tap under it (Ben 06:51 and 06:53, product/words.md; decisions.md 2026-11-15 cross-listing starts on same take-home). A demo item posted before the rule was a choice carries Same price as its own (agent proposal).
A pick that changes nothing public still brings up Save once the person makes it, an ending or a ship method included (pages §6.7: the foot comes when something changes).
